pages.text: $(bold)Purpose: $(reset)the complete form of the Altar of the Black Mother — a 2×2 core of mother altars acts as the anchor, with three tiers stacked downward.$(br2)$(bold)Tiers: $(reset)$(li)$(reset)Tier 1$(reset): top altar layer + the layer beneath it$(li)$(reset)Tier 2$(reset): tier 1 + the next layer down$(li)$(reset)Tier 3$(reset): tier 2 + the bottom layer (including the beacon structure)$(br2)Any core mother altar re-checks itself every 20 ticks and reports the $(reset)highest contiguous tier$(reset); the tier is stored on all four altars and synced to the client.

pages.name: Black Goat Altar (16×16×4)
pages.text: $(bold)Layers (top to bottom, 4 total): $(reset)$(li)y=-57 top: C=mother altar (red 0 is the anchor)$(li)y=-58 bedding: A=altar stone, B=essence block, E=bone block, H=crying obsidian, D=beacon$(li)y=-59 middle: I=beacon base squares + E/B/A ring steps$(li)y=-60 bottom: H=crying obsidian frame, A=altar stone$(br2)$(reset)The beacon structure belongs to tier 3 only$(reset): at tiers 1/2 the D (beacon) and I (base) cells are ignored, so any block may occupy them. Tier 3 requires real beacons, and any base block that $(reset)can power a beacon$(reset) works - iron, gold, diamond, emerald or netherite blocks. The whole structure is 90°-rotation symmetric, so $(reset)any facing works$(reset).

pages.title: Tier Detection
pages.text: $(bold)Rule: $(reset)validation starts at tier 1 and climbs layer by layer; the count of contiguous layers is the tier. One missing solid block falls back to the previous tier, down to 0 (incomplete). $(bold)Air cells: $(reset)blank cells accept any block and never affect detection.$(br2)$(bold)Anchor: $(reset)any of the four core mother altars $(reset)can trigger the scan$(reset); each reports the same tier independently.$(br2)$(bold)Current stage: $(reset)structure detection, tier sync, formation (merging at tier 1+) and the $(reset)Life Fusion Ritual$(reset) are all live.

pages.title: Life Fusion Ritual
pages.text: $(bold)Offerings: $(reset)put $(reset)1 Akaishi Ingot$(reset) on the mother altar, then 1 item on each of the 8 outer sub-altars: $(reset)2 Life Embryos, 2 Life Ashes, 2 Gene Sequences with purity >50, and 2 Chishi Essence Blocks$(reset) - all 8 altars must be filled exactly; one extra or one wrong item fails the recipe.$(br2)$(bold)Charging: $(reset)feed life energy into the mother altar with the $(reset)Life Energy Emitter$(reset) (bind the altar first with the wand); the progress bar settles at $(reset)80K$(reset), each projectile delivering 8K.$(br2)$(bold)Lightning: $(reset)every $(reset)10%$(reset) of progress calls down a $(reset)visual-only bolt$(reset) (beam and thunder, but $(reset)no fire and no damage$(reset)): milestones 1-9 strike the 8 outer sub-altars in structure order, and milestone 10 (progress full) $(reset)strikes the center of the great altar$(reset).$(br2)$(bold)Outcome: $(reset)with the recipe complete, $(reset)every offering is consumed$(reset) and $(reset)1 Life Fusion Ingot$(reset) forms in the mother altar slot (floating display; take it by right-click or via the screen). An incomplete recipe leaves progress pinned at full until the offerings are corrected.$(br2)$(bold)Energy source: $(reset)the altar $(reset)refuses any pipe-fed energy$(reset) - only the emitter works; the emitter stops automatically once the target is full.$(br2)$(bold)No whitelist: $(reset)there is no allow/deny list - $(reset)any item can be offered$(reset); a wrong item simply never joins the recipe.

pages.title: After Formation
pages.text: $(bold)Trigger: $(reset)a tier of $(reset)1 or higher$(reset) forms the shrine; dropping to 0 (core block broken) dissolves it and $(reset)reverts everything$(reset).$(br2)$(bold)Merged altar: $(reset)the four core altars each render a quarter of the great-altar model, $(reset)seamlessly joined$(reset), topped by a $(reset)red blanket$(reset).$(br2)$(bold)Right-click: $(reset)once formed, right-click any of the four core altars to open the $(reset)merged altar screen$(reset) - it shows the $(reset)current tier$(reset) and one offering slot ($(reset)single item$(reset) only, any item accepted).$(br2)$(bold)Crimson veins: $(reset)once formed, $(reset)crying obsidian$(reset) turns red by tier - the $(reset)y=-58 bedding is always crimson$(reset), while the $(reset)y=-60 bottom layer is crimson at tier 3 only$(reset); purple veins become flowing red ones. $(reset)Obsidian added later$(reset) converts automatically within seconds.$(br2)$(bold)Eight red glows: $(reset)the 8 outer sub-altars shift from purple to a $(reset)red glow$(reset) (visual only; they still take offerings).$(br2)$(bold)Reverting: $(reset)breaking a required block of layer 1 (y=-57 top / y=-58 bedding) drops the tier to 0 - crimson reverts to crying obsidian, red glows go out and the four altars split back to single form (offerings are $(reset)ejected and returned$(reset) altar by altar when merging).$(br2)$(bold)Downgrading: $(reset)breaking only deeper layers (y=-59 / y=-60) does not dissolve the shrine; it downgrades to the remaining tier - crimson beyond that tier reverts to plain crying obsidian, and turns red again once restored.
Prerequisite: read "Altar of the Black Mother" first for the single-altar offering interaction.
